description: Shep's 1:1 prep for Alice Mburu (2026-10-16) attributed the Houston travel recovery to Alice without evidence: claimed she 'moved you off the JSX flight and onto a Southwest' (David did that himself) and claimed she 'chased the hotel to update checkout to the 14th and waive the early-departure fee' (David is unsure this happened). Presented as a named recognition point in talking point 6.
correction: David moved himself to the Southwest flight. The hotel checkout-waiver claim is unverified. Do not attribute actions to a person without a source that names them doing it.
root_cause: Inferred agency from topic co-occurrence in the Teams thread rather than from evidence naming the actor.
